To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Copper slag and metakaolin as partial replacement to natural sand and fly ash respectively in self compacting concrete exhibited higher durability properties.

copper slag can be used as a replacement for natural sand in self compacting concrete with 20% substitution level and 10% metakaolin as replacement to fly ash to achieve better strength and durability properties.
Copper slag (CS) and metakaolin are the potential substitute for natural sand and fly ash respectively in the construction industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the durability performance of SCC incorporating copper slag and metakaolin.
the use of CS in SCC with MK as a replacement for FA.
the development of self compacting high strength concrete incorporating copper slag (0-100% replacement) as fine aggregate and metakaolin as partial substitute for fly ash (10% replacement).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of CS as fine aggregate and MK as mineral admixtures into SCC is a promising and effective method for improving the durability of SCC.
the incorporation of copper slag as a partial replacement for fine aggregate in the concrete mix design can be considered a good option for sustainable development of concrete.
the incorporation of CS as fine aggregate in self-compacting concrete with metakaolin as mineral admixture can improve the durability of SCC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CS is an excellent substitute for natural sand and MK can be used as partial replacement of FA in SCC.

the use of copper slag and metakaolin as partial replacement for natural sand and cementitious materials respectively in the production of self compacting concretes can be considered as a promising and sustainable alternative for the construction industry.
CS can be used as a partial replacement for sand in the production of SCC.

copper slag can be used in self compacting concrete to improve the durability of concrete.
the durability of concrete can be significantly improved by incorporating MK with CS as a partial replacement for FA.
